tips.text: Buy the limited-time Cred offerings first and pick Vauban up with leftover Creds; he is there every week.
Open the store from the Cred Offerings prompt in the bottom corner of the Nightwave screen.
Spend your Creds before the season ends; leftovers from an ended season expire.
Ignore the Vauban Prime farm threads; the Oxium, Cryotic and Nitain bill does not apply to base Vauban.
Start all three components together and keep a free Warframe slot for the final build.
Take him for the Mastery even if you skip the kit; 75 Creds buys a whole frame.
Players call base Vauban painless: one Nightwave rank, common resources, then the 3-day build.
